title: Bound on larger entries in a sorted list
statement: Let $s$ be a list in a linearly ordered type, arranged in nondecreasing order, and let $j$ be an index with $j<|s|$. The number of entries of $s$ strictly greater than the entry at index $j$ is at most $|s|-1-j$.
hypotheses_covered: The entries lie in a linearly ordered type
